title: Yann LeCun’s second attempt at a VC fund lands with $100M and Gemini’s co-lead as a partner
excerpt: LeCun and Oriol Vinyals join 224 Ventures, a new AI fund with $100M+ in assets. It targets early stage AI startups with $1M-$5M checks. LPs are mostly AI insiders.
content_html:
TL;DR

LeCun and Oriol Vinyals join 224 Ventures, a new AI fund with $100M+ in assets. Targets early stage AI with $1M-$5M checks. University of Illinois is anchor investor. LPs are mostly AI insiders.

Yann LeCun has found a VC fund that will actually launch. The Meta former chief AI scientist is joining 224 Ventures, a new firm that announced Wednesday with more than $100 million in assets under management. His co-partner is Oriol Vinyals, who until today served as Gemini’s co-technical lead at Google DeepMind. Shaun Johnson, who co-founded AI-focused firm AIX Ventures, will run the firm.

The timing is hard to miss. Vinyals announced his departure from DeepMind today alongside Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, and Quoc Le, all four leaving to co-found Discovery Loop, a startup aimed at automating science and engineering. He is now simultaneously launching a startup and joining a venture fund, with 224 Ventures serving as his formal investing vehicle.

The fund is targeting $81 million for its core early stage vehicle, with about $30 million raised so far. It has also invested more than $60 million in growth-stage AI companies through special-purpose vehicles. Once the early stage fund closes, total assets should reach at least $150 million, according to Johnson. The University of Illinois is the anchor investor.

224 Ventures will write checks between $1 million and $5 million, targeting startups valued under $100 million. It will not lead rounds. The focus is early stage AI applications, especially research talent building capital-efficient models. Robotics and AI infrastructure are also on the list. The firm has already made multiple undisclosed investments.

LeCun and Vinyals were already active angel investors. Both backed Perplexity before it became one of the most talked-about AI startups. LeCun also invested in Groq, which Nvidia later acquired in a $20 billion licensing and talent deal. Johnson invested in Perplexity and voice tech maker Wispr AI through AIX Ventures before departing that firm in December.

The fund’s investor base is unusual. The majority of its limited partners are individuals working in AI, including researchers at frontier labs, startup founders, and Fortune 500 leaders. That network is the pitch: deal flow and portfolio support from people who build AI, not just fund it. LeCun’s last VC venture, Extelligence Invest, collapsed within eight hours in July over undisclosed “exclusive relationships” with other funds. He called that episode a miscommunication at the time. 224 Ventures appears to have resolved whatever the conflict was.

LeCun will retain his role as executive chairman of AMI Labs, the world-models startup he raised $1 billion for in March. He described 224 Ventures as a way to pool resources with Vinyals and support founders while staying on top of new AI developments. All three partners will invest exclusively through the firm, vote on investments together, and split any profits equally.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

LeCun 和 Oriol Vinyals 加入 224 Ventures，这是一家资产超过 1 亿美元的新人工智能基金。 以 100 万至 500 万美元的支票瞄准早期人工智能。 伊利诺伊大学是主要投资者。 LP大多是AI内部人士。

Yann LeCun 已经找到了一支将实际启动的风险投资基金。 这位 Meta 前首席人工智能科学家将加入 224 Ventures，这是一家新公司，该公司于周三宣布管理资产超过 1 亿美元。 他的合作伙伴是 Oriol Vinyals，迄今为止，他一直担任 Gemini 在 Google DeepMind 的联合技术主管。 专注于人工智能的公司 AIX Ventures 的联合创始人肖恩·约翰逊 (Shaun Johnson) 将负责运营该公司。

时机不容错过。 Vinyals 今天宣布离开 DeepMind，与 Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat 和 Quoc Le 一起离开，四人共同创立了 Discovery Loop，一家致力于自动化科学和工程的初创公司。 他现在正在同时创办一家初创公司并加入一家风险基金，224 Ventures 是他的正式投资工具。

该基金的核心早期投资目标为 8100 万美元，迄今为止已筹集约 3000 万美元。 它还通过特殊用途工具向成长阶段的人工智能公司投资了超过 6000 万美元。 约翰逊表示，一旦早期基金结束，总资产应至少达到 1.5 亿美元。 伊利诺伊大学是主要投资者。

224 Ventures 将开出 100 万至 500 万美元的支票，目标是估值低于 1 亿美元的初创公司。 它不会引导回合。 重点是早期人工智能应用，特别是构建资本效率模型的研究人才。 机器人和人工智能基础设施也在名单上。 该公司已经进行了多项未公开的投资。

LeCun 和 Vinyals 已经是活跃的天使投资人。 在 Perplexity 成为最受关注的人工智能初创公司之一之前，两人都对它进行了支持。 LeCun 还投资了 Groq，Nvidia 后来以 200 亿美元的许可和人才交易收购了该公司。 Johnson 通过 AIX Ventures 投资了 Perplexity 和语音技术制造商 Wispr AI，然后于 12 月离开该公司。

该基金的投资者基础不同寻常。 其大多数有限合伙人都是从事人工智能工作的个人，包括前沿实验室的研究人员、初创公司创始人和财富 500 强领导人。 这个网络就是宣传：来自人工智能构建者的交易流和投资组合支持，而不仅仅是为其提供资金。 LeCun 的最后一家风险投资公司 Extelligence Invest 在 7 月份的八小时内就因与其他基金未公开的“排他关系”而倒闭。 他当时称那件事是沟通不畅。 224 Ventures 似乎已经解决了所有冲突。

LeCun 将继续担任 AMI Labs 执行主席，该公司是一家世界模特初创公司，他在 3 月份为这家公司筹集了 10 亿美元资金。 他将 224 Ventures 描述为一种与 Vinyals 汇集资源并支持创始人的方式，同时保持新的人工智能发展的领先地位。 所有三个合伙人将通过该公司进行独家投资，共同对投资进行投票，并平均分配任何利润。
